channel.title: The Colorado Sun - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Colorado Sun (coloradosun.com)

item.title: “My child’s life is expendable”: Fight for gender-affirming care and risk of federal defunding plays out in a Denver courtroom
item.description: Families of transgender kids are suing Children’s Hospital Colorado, saying that the hospital’s decision to suspend gender-affirming care for minors violates a state anti-discrimination law

item.title: Trump’s freeze of $10B in funds for low-income families in Colorado, 4 other states blocked by federal judge
item.description: $300 million will continue to flow to Colorado's child care and safety net programs, per a preliminary injunction issued Friday

item.title: Colorado man who abused nearly 200 corpses gets 40 years in prison, families call him a “monster”
item.description: Jon Hallford apologized before his sentencing and said he would regret his actions for the rest of his life

item.title: What’s Working: How Denver’s Art Gym went from private passion project to artist co-op
item.description: It required more than creative thinking. Plus: State Demographer explains Colorado’s population growth, DougCo lands aerospace star tracker, AT&T’s internet purchase, paid-health care internships and more!

item.title: Graduating high school in Gunnison or Hinsdale counties? Western Colorado University will give you free tuition this fall.
item.description: The university is wiping out higher education costs for students in hopes of keeping more high school graduates in the Gunnison Valley

item.title: Old Firehouse Books suggests tales around music, religion and sleep
item.description: Old Firehouse Books in Fort Collins recommends a story about a girls grunge band, some nonfiction about religious abuse and a nocturnal mystery.

item.title: Holiday ornaments led Jody Pritzl to the people, politics of postage
item.description: After her book about Christmas ornaments, Jody Pritzl studied people and politics behind the seasonal stamps.

item.title: “The December Dilemma” puts its stamp on postal intrigue
item.description: In "The December Dilemma," Jody Pritzl's look at Christmas postage, she takes readers behind the scenes to witness the intersection of art and politics.

item.title: Nicolais: When even federal prosecutors are frightened, we should all be afraid
item.description: An unexpected moment of insightfulness from a federal prosecutor in Minnesota last week made it clear how close our country is to a judicial collapse

item.title: Ken Salazar embodies southern Colorado history. He just gave boxes of it to History Colorado’s Borderlands project.
item.description: The initiative preserving the region’s multicultural past will benefit from a trove of papers and career artifacts
